League outcomes are reference anchors for fan mobilization: FC vote closes before the show, and on-site support is registered at entry. Same-day performance should mainly drive conversion, buzz, and next-round lift.

Regular season from May 2025, FINAL / 入れ替え戦 through 2026-02-07 (incl. 2026-01-13 Osaka promotion), then 2026-04-24 昇格戦 closes the season.
Regular league from May 2026 (after 25-26 昇格戦). League I scoring adds ABEMA PPV votes alongside on-site attendance + FC vote.

design_notes.player_agency: No SNS/FC-campaign minigame. Setlist pickup, training, and lineup/roster (core + new members) shape long-term fans and short-term vote/draw. New joins may add immediate attention/fans as well as integration costs.
design_notes.scoring: Season points come from matchday rank tables driven by FC pre-vote + on-site mobilization/attendance (26-27 League I also Abema). Sim should map managed-group mobilization power into expected ranks, then accumulate pts against these historical baselines.
design_notes.akishibu_example: アキシブproject 25-26 regular: 15→85→105→110→125→180 (7th after tiebreak). Peak MD2 (2nd/70), collapse MD3–4, MD6 bounce (3rd/55) is best interpreted as Graduation Last-Chance Mobilization: 古賀みれい graduation was announced 2025-05-02 and held 2025-09-29, five days after the 9/24 League final. It is not a natural mid-pack baseline recovery.
design_notes.live_causality: Performance(t) mostly affects satisfaction, conversion, SNS buzz, and Mobilization(t+1), not already-locked FC votes or entry-registered on-site support for the same round.
design_notes.mobilization_semantics: Recorded on-site mobilization means valid entrants counted for a group at entry, not necessarily concurrent audience or engaged viewers. Keep ticketed/counted mobilization, concurrent audience, and engaged audience conceptually separate.
design_notes.akishibu_promotion: 入れ替え戦: 50→130→195→225→255 (5th). Peaked vol.2 (2nd/80) still inside I-line through vol.3; Osaka vol.4 slip (6th/30) then final 6th/30 left them 5pt short of chuLa for the last I slot.

gameplay_goals.primary: League I safety: finish regular season above the 入れ替え線 (avoid bottom 4) so you never play promotion matches.
gameplay_goals.recovery: If you fall into 入れ替え戦, survive: finish top 4 to stay/promote into League I.
gameplay_goals.stretch: Championship path: regular-season top band → 決勝リーグ (aspirational; not required for I survival).
gameplay_goals.reference_failure: アキシブproject 25-26: lost I safety on attendance tiebreak (7th), then finished 5th in 入れ替え戦 (255) — 55 short of chuLa — demoted to II.

agency_model.avoid: Do not simulate X/Twitter FC-vote spam or social posting loops.
agency_model.long_term: Fan/popularity stock from lives + media, compounded by setlist quality, training, and roster choices (core retention and new joins).
agency_model.short_term: Matchday vote/attendance proxy from mobilizable core, campaign effort, urgency/narrative, schedule availability, and proxy/social mobilization. Live readiness feeds mostly future conversion unless rules grant a small audience-response bonus.
agency_model.lineup: Lineup/roster is a first-class lever: rest vs spotlight core, farewell last League shows, and add/rotate members.
agency_model.new_members: New members are not pure short-term pain. They can attract attention and introduce fans immediately (discovery / personal draw), while also stressing setlist familiarity, chemistry, and condition load. Net matchday effect depends on who joins and how you stage them — not automatically hurt-now/help-later.

scoring_rules.summary: Matchday rank is decided by HEROINES FC pre-vote + on-site mobilization/attendance (目当て registered at entry). Season points are awarded from a fixed rank→pt table (not raw vote totals). From 26-27, League I also adds ABEMA PPV vote weight.

notes: MD1 (2025-05-11) was attendance-only; FC voting started from MD2 (2025-06-14).
Venue/on-site vote is sometimes mentioned in series blurbs alongside attendance + FC.
Late joiner (iON!): missed-round pts = floor(avg(participated)*0.7 to 1 decimal) * missedCount, then floor.
入れ替え戦 / 決勝リーグ use denser 8- or 4-group tables (promotion: 100/80/65/50/40/30/20/10).
League I adds ABEMA PPV ticket-linked votes on top of on-site + FC.
